description: This file defines the ImageController class responsible for serving dynamically resized images in a web application. It includes methods for image processing, caching, and HTTP response handling within the Goteo project.

classes.name: ImageController
classes.description: Controller class for handling image requests and resizing.

methods.name: indexAction
methods.description: Handles image display requests, resizes images based on predefined or custom parameters, and returns an HTTP response with image data.

methods.name: oldIndexAction
methods.description: Redirects to an older image URL format with specified dimensions and cropping options.
